sloka: ततस्तेन दशग्रीवो यक्षेन्द्रेण महात्मना ।गदयाभिहतो मूर्ध्नि न च स्थानात्प्रकम्पितः ।। ७.१५.२९ ॥
transliteration: tatastena daśagrīvo yakṣendreṇa mahātmanā ।gadayābhihato mūrdhni na ca sthānātprakampitaḥ ।। 7.15.29 ॥

translations.english: Then, the great-souled lord of Yakshas struck Dashagriva on the head with a mace, but Ravana was not shaken from his position.
